_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session B7: plan exposure_1 on ruadapt_qwen2.5_7B_ext_u48_instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, one per card. These are the two models still missing from the MKB-10 and OKVED 2 row cells and the frozen distance bins. In B6, Qwen2.5-7B and T-lite named the next MKB-10 rubric once in 121 far prompts, as the Nemo pair did, against 18 for the from-scratch YandexGPT models (reports/RESULTS_EXPOSURE.md Part XII). With these two runs every model run so far has both exposure plans: ruadapt is the vocabulary-extended adaptation, Llama the off-family control. Llama is gated: the Kaggle secret HF_TOKEN must be attached, and the run prints '[hf] token: from the Kaggle secret HF_TOKEN'. iris anchors the plan: 76/142 and 12/142, byte for byte, as in their earlier sessions. Planning figures from src/price_plan.py with each model's own tokenizer, every answer to its budget x 1.15, validated on 46 runs (actual/plan 0.68-0.94): ruadapt 6.1 h; Llama 7.5 h, priced as the 12B family on purpose (its three runs took 0.68-0.75 of that figure). The longer card is 7.5 h, about 5.3 h at Llama's ratio.
attached_input: the nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached as one Kaggle dataset (loose or zipped); the fetch step adopts them from /kaggle/input, looks inside zips, and verifies every hash before any weights load. The Kaggle secret HF_TOKEN must be attached to the notebook for Llama
disk: two checkpoints at once, about 32 GB at the peak (ruadapt-Qwen 15.5 + Llama 16.1, neither with custom code)

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: MKB-10 and OKVED 2 row completion with the frozen distance bins, plus header and row on the other three files; 7.5 h; the off-family control. Queued first so that it takes a card at once
the same cells, same seed, the other card; 6.1 h; Qwen2.5-7B's vocabulary-extended Russian adaptation, paired with Qwen's B6 run on identical prompts. Needs the T4 x2 accelerator
